[[The Ascension]] is a [[legendary back item]] made available through [[PvP League]]s in 2016. Earning this item also unlocks a unique [[The Ascension (glider)|glider skin]]. The precursor and the respective gifts can still be obtained as of [[PvP League]] Season 35. The way of acquiring these may change in the future.<ref>[https://forum-en.gw2archive.eu/forum/game/pvp/Stopped-dead-on-Wings/page/2#post6067744 Post by Hugh Norfolk], Guild Wars 2 Forum</ref><ref>[https://www.guildwars2.com/en/news/pvp-leagues-and-sloth-attack-on-guild-chat-a-summary/ Guild Chat, episode 32 summary], Guild Wars 2 official website</ref>

== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|A handful of warriors know what it's like to bask in the effervescent glow of a fresh victory—sweat dripping from their brow, voice raw. Only the bravest ascend to such glory.}}

== Visual effects ==
{{YouTube search}}
* The Ascension has an animation that leaves a tiny blast on both hands when drawing a weapon for the first time (This can be noticed while running and drawing the weapon)
* The same weapon drawing blast animation is replaced with a single blast animation when swapping weapons (perform at least one autoattack before swapping, for this animation to trigger)
* Purple and orange flame particles flow from the bottom of the wings, the effect and colours of these are more pronounced when weapons are drawn.
* There are small glowing dust particles that emanate from the wings, these are more prominent in darker places or at night.

== Notes ==
* The Ascension and its related back items display the same pattern as the spire structure in the [[Inner Chamber|inner chamber]] of [[Tarir, the Forgotten City]] and [[the Hall of Heroes]].
* The Ascension can only be made once because the [[Gift of the Competitor]] is composed of achievement rewards that are rewarded only once.
* Multiple top stats in a ranked game contributes to the top stats achievement.
* Winning a ranked game on a profession ticks all unlocked league tiers on that profession. This ensures progress of the latest Path of the Ascension tier when deciding to use a different profession in later tiers.
* Upon entering a higher Path of the Ascension tier, the current day cannot count for a daily league participator.
